TC-21/S16.title: Step 1 per context: identity fields on the card, summary label, billing-family hint
TC-21/S16.detail: Local 25acd727. 8/9 judged passed: Hospital card shows the chief diagnosis; Hospital chart 'Background Summary', NH chart 'Admission Summary', never the other; Hospital Encounter carries no NH code; NH Encounter pre-selects SNF follow-up with the '99307–99310' hint and no Hospital code; the new SNF consult hint reads '99304–99306' and SNF discharge '99315 / 99316 by time'. Failed 1/9: the Nursing Home card shows the resident's diagnosis ('Post-acute rehab after hip fracture'); UAT TC-01 / TC-03 say no diagnosis on the NH card — known B28.
TC-21/S16.productIssue: The Nursing Home resident card shows the diagnosis line, which the UAT says belongs on Hospital cards only (known B28).
